[LSIG.3.4] `gap skip` requires a schema with bounded scope (`scope ttl N` or
`scope explicit`) so that a fact can go dead between assertions. On a
`scope logical` schema no fact can go dead, so there is nothing for `gap skip`
to exclude; the compiler must reject
`gap skip` on `scope logical` with `DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_GAP_SKIP_LOGICAL`
(error — reject).
